about.title: About Fropty Hub
about.intro: Fropty Hub is the client portal of the Fropty ecosystem — the place where everything connects.

sections.p: A single environment to track support tickets, projects, contracts, billing, knowledge base, roadmap and much more. Each client only sees what they subscribed to.
Fropty offers digital modules and services for companies — such as FroptyCash, FroptyInvest, FroptySentinel, FroptyCRM and FroptyApps — brought together and integrated in the Hub.
The Hub is protected by FroptySentinel, with two-factor authentication, leaked-password checks and continuous monitoring.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By accessing and using Fropty Hub, you agree to the terms described below.

sections.p: Access is personal and intended for clients with an active contract. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential.
The data you enter in the Hub belongs to the client. Fropty uses it only to provide the contracted services.
We aim for high availability, but the service may undergo scheduled maintenance, announced in advance whenever possible.
These terms may be updated. Significant changes will be communicated through the official channels.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we handle your data.

sections.p: We collect only the data needed to run the Hub: account information, usage activity and the content you create (tickets, projects, feedback).
We use the data to authenticate access, provide support, improve the platform and comply with legal obligations. We do not sell your data.
You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time through our contact channels.
Privacy questions can be sent to suporte@fropty.com.
